rows.label: fev06_380_125_msg0001
rows.name:
The path to the Sanctus
Chain is quite treacherous.

rows.label: fev06_380_125_msg0002
rows.name:
This royal capital, Teos Aure, is far
above the Genbu Great Snowfield.

rows.label: fev06_380_125_msg0003
rows.name:
Leave the palace and head down to the
left. You'll find the ruins of
Theospisti Temple.

rows.label: fev06_380_125_msg0004
rows.name: There are ruins inside the city, mo?

rows.label: fev06_380_125_msg0005
rows.name:
Yep, that's right. They're
basically falling apart!

rows.label: fev06_380_125_msg0006
rows.name:
Past that is the Teos Aure
back gate, and that's where
we'll head outside...

rows.label: fev06_380_125_msg0007
rows.name:
After that, we'll need to
follow the pillars and keep
heading down and down.

rows.label: fev06_380_125_msg0008
rows.name: Ugh... That sounds really tough.

rows.label: fev06_380_125_msg0009
rows.name:
But we need to hurry, mo! Let's get to
the Genbu Great Snowfield as fast as
we can, mo!

rows.label: fev06_380_125_msg0010
rows.name: Hold on, I'm not done explaining yet.

rows.label: fev06_380_125_msg0011
rows.name:
Once we get to the Genbu Great
Snowfield, we'll need to cross right
through it.

rows.label: fev06_380_125_msg0012
rows.name:
That gets us to a place called the
Great Pillar Passage. The Sanctus
Chain's at the end of that.

rows.label: fev06_380_125_msg0013
rows.name:
Just hearing how far it is has already
crushed Tora's spirit, mo...

rows.label: fev06_380_125_msg0014
rows.name: Master, that's too soon, mo!

rows.label: fev06_380_125_msg0015
rows.name: Tora, this is no time for jokes.

rows.label: fev06_380_125_msg0016
rows.name:
It's to protect Zeke's
homeland. Let's do our best.

rows.label: fev06_380_125_msg0017
rows.name: Of course, mo!

rows.label: fev06_380_125_msg0018
rows.name: Yes, let's do our best!

rows.label: fev06_380_125_msg0019
rows.name: Yeah! Everyone, I'm counting on you!

rows.label: fev06_380_125_msg0020
rows.name:
So first, we head out from
here and go left, got it?

rows.label: fev06_380_125_msg0021
rows.name: I know, mooo!
